summary: Move-out cleaning done to the real estate agent's checklist, from the oven to the window tracks, across Newcastle and the Hunter.
body:
Moving out of a rental is stressful enough without spending your last night scrubbing an oven. Our end of lease cleaning in Newcastle and across the Hunter is built around one goal: handing the property back in the condition your real estate agent expects, so the final inspection is a formality rather than a back-and-forth. We clean to the checklist real estate agents use, we bring our own equipment and products, and all you need to do is get your belongings out and leave us the keys.

Under NSW tenancy rules, tenants need to leave a property reasonably clean and in the same condition as the ingoing condition report, apart from fair wear and tear. That report is what your agent compares against, so it's what we clean against too.

## What our end of lease cleaning in Newcastle covers

Every job follows a room-by-room checklist, and you can see the full list further down this page. The areas agents look at hardest are nearly always the same:

- **Kitchen** – oven, racks, trays, cooktop and rangehood filters degreased; cupboards and drawers wiped inside and out; splashback, sink and taps cleaned and polished.
- **Bathrooms** – soap scum and water marks removed from shower screens, tiles and taps; grout scrubbed; toilet cleaned inside and out, including the base and behind it.
- **Bedrooms and living areas** – built-in wardrobes inside and out, skirting boards, doors and frames, light switches and power points, plus marks spot-cleaned from walls where they'll safely come off.
- **Windows and tracks** – inside glass, sills and window tracks, plus sliding doors and their tracks.
- **Floors** – vacuumed and mopped edge to edge, including inside wardrobes.

Extras such as balconies, garages, blinds and reachable outside windows can be added when you request your quote.

## Who we clean for

- **Tenants moving out** who would rather spend moving week packing than degreasing.
- **Students and share houses** near the University of Newcastle, in suburbs like [Jesmond](/areas/jesmond), [Shortland](/areas/shortland) and [Waratah](/areas/waratah), where several housemates leave at once and nobody wants to own the kitchen.
- **Landlords and property managers** who need a place turned around quickly between tenancies.
- **Families relocating** within or out of the Hunter, including Defence families on posting around Williamtown and [Medowie](/areas/medowie).

## How the job runs

1. **Quote** – tell us the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the general condition, whether you've had pets, and your inspection date. We'll come back with a free, no-obligation quote.
2. **Book around your keys** – the best time is after the furniture is out and before the final inspection. Weekend slots are available, but end-of-month dates fill quickly, so book as soon as you know your move date.
3. **We clean** – the team works through the checklist room by room and finishes with the floors, so nothing gets walked over once it's done.
4. **Hand over** – we lock up and leave the keys the way you've arranged, whether that's a lockbox, your agent's office or back with you.
5. **Inspection** – if your agent flags something that's on our checklist, let us know and we'll work with you to put it right.

## What affects the price

No two rentals are the same, which is why we quote each job rather than publish a flat rate. Your quote depends on:

- **Size** – bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas and the number of storeys.
- **Condition** – how long since the last thorough clean, build-up in the oven and rangehood, and any mould in wet areas.
- **Pets** – hair in carpets and on skirting boards, and any lingering odour.
- **Extras** – walls, blinds, balconies, garages and outside windows.
- **Access and timing** – stairs, lifts, parking and how tight the window is between moving out and the inspection.

A few photos of the oven, bathrooms and any problem spots help us quote accurately the first time.

## Local know-how for Newcastle and Hunter rentals

Rentals here throw up a few regular challenges, and we plan for them before we arrive:

- **Coastal homes** in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Stockton](/areas/stockton) and [Nelson Bay](/areas/nelson-bay) collect a salty film on glass, sliding doors and aluminium tracks. We wash it off properly rather than smearing it around.
- **Heritage terraces** in [Cooks Hill](/areas/cooks-hill) and [Newcastle East](/areas/newcastle-east) have high ceilings, ornate cornices, steep stairs and tight street parking, so we allow extra time and bring the right ladders.
- **Newer estates** in [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm), [Thornton](/areas/thornton) and [Gillieston Heights](/areas/gillieston-heights) pick up fine dust from surrounding building sites. It settles in tracks, vents and window frames, and agents notice it.
- **Humid summers** leave mould spots on bathroom ceilings and exhaust fan covers. We treat surface mould as part of the clean.

## Before we arrive

- Move everything out, including the cleaning products under the sink and anything left in the fridge or freezer.
- Leave the power and water connected; we need hot water and working lights.
- Have your ingoing condition report handy and tell us about anything the agent has already raised.
- If your lease mentions professional carpet cleaning, mention it when you ask for a quote so we can talk it through.

## Book your end of lease clean

Ready to hand back the keys? [Request a free quote](/quote) or call 0411 463 552 with your move-out date and property details. If you're a landlord selling rather than re-leasing, see our [pre-sale cleaning](/services/pre-sale-cleaning) service, and if your new place needs a thorough once-over before you unpack, our [deep cleaning](/services/deep-cleaning) team can help.

body:
A clean house makes the rest of the week easier. Our house cleaning service in Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland and across the Hunter gives you that back without giving up your Saturday. A trained local team comes in on a schedule that suits you, weekly, fortnightly or monthly, and works through the kitchen, bathrooms, floors and dusting to a consistent checklist. We bring our own equipment and products, with eco-friendly options on request, so there's nothing for you to buy or store.

## What a regular house cleaning visit in Newcastle includes

Each visit covers the jobs that keep a home feeling looked after:

- **Kitchen** – benchtops, splashback and sink cleaned; cooktop and appliance fronts wiped; microwave cleaned inside and out; bins emptied; floor vacuumed and mopped.
- **Bathrooms and toilets** – shower, screen, bath and basin cleaned; mirrors polished; toilet cleaned and sanitised inside and out; floors mopped.
- **Bedrooms** – reachable surfaces dusted, beds made (or linen changed if you leave fresh sheets out), mirrors cleaned and floors vacuumed.
- **Living areas** – surfaces, shelves and TV units dusted, cobwebs removed, glass smudges wiped, and floors vacuumed and mopped.
- **Throughout** – light switches and door handles wiped, and rubbish taken out to your bins.

The full room-by-room list is further down the page. Oven and fridge interiors, inside windows and other extras can be added to any visit.

## Weekly, fortnightly or monthly?

- **Weekly** suits busy families, homes with pets, and anyone who wants the house at the same standard all the time.
- **Fortnightly** suits many couples and smaller households. Bathrooms and kitchens stay under control and dust never really builds up.
- **Monthly** works for tidy households who just want a reset, or as a top-up between your own cleaning.
- **One-off cleans** are handy before guests arrive, after a busy stretch at work, or after a big event at home.

You can change the frequency later, for example moving to weekly visits during a busy school term and back to fortnightly over the holidays.

## Your first clean

The first visit usually takes longer than the rest. We're learning your home, and we're also catching up on anything that has built up, such as soap scum on shower screens or grease on the rangehood. If it has been a while, we may suggest starting with a [deep clean](/services/deep-cleaning) so your regular visits can focus on keeping things at that level rather than catching up.

Before the first visit we'll ask about your priorities, any rooms to skip, products you'd like us to use or avoid, pets, and how you'd like us to get in.

## How regular visits work

- **Access** – many clients aren't home when we clean. A spare key, lockbox or garage code works fine, and we lock up when we leave.
- **Consistency** – we aim to keep the same team on your home where we can, so they get to know how you like things done.
- **Notes** – want extra attention on the shower this week, or the spare room left alone? Tell us before the visit and we'll adjust.
- **Rescheduling** – plans change. Let us know as early as you can and we'll find another time.

## What affects the price

Your quote is based on your home and the way you want it looked after:

- Number of bedrooms, bathrooms and living areas.
- How often we visit; regular visits generally take less time than occasional ones.
- Pets, especially heavy shedders.
- Stairs, floor types and how much needs moving before we can clean.
- Extras such as the oven, fridge, inside windows, balcony or linen changes.

Quotes are free and there's no obligation.

## Cleaning homes the Newcastle way

Homes around Newcastle and the Hunter have their own habits, and our cleaners know them:

- **Beach sand and salt** come home with you from Merewether, Bar Beach and Redhead. Sand ends up in sliding door tracks, entry mats and showers, and salt haze dulls glass.
- **Humid summers** make bathrooms prone to mould on ceilings, grout and silicone, especially in older homes without strong exhaust fans. Regular cleaning stops it taking hold.
- **Growing estates** in [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm), [Thornton](/areas/thornton) and around [Lake Macquarie](/areas/lake-macquarie) collect dust from nearby building sites for years after you move in.
- **Older homes** in [Lambton](/areas/lambton), [Adamstown](/areas/adamstown) and [Hamilton](/areas/hamilton) often have timber floors, picture rails and high ceilings that need gentle products and a longer reach.
- **Shift workers**, from hospital staff at John Hunter to mine and Defence rosters around [Singleton](/areas/singleton), often prefer visits while they're at work, so the house is done when they get home.

body:
A regular clean keeps a home ticking over. A deep clean resets it. Our deep cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter goes after the build-up a weekly wipe-down misses: grease on rangehood filters, grime along skirting boards, soap scum baked onto shower screens, and dust on top of door frames and in window tracks. It's a once-off, top-to-bottom job, done by a trained team with their own equipment and products, and it's the clean most people book in spring, before Christmas, or before moving into a new place.

## When a deep clean makes sense

- **Spring cleaning** – after a winter of closed windows, heaters and wet dogs, a full reset before the warmer months.
- **Before the holidays or big visits** – getting the house ready for Christmas, family staying over or a celebration at home.
- **Moving in** – the previous occupants' grime isn't something you want to unpack into.
- **Before starting regular cleaning** – a deep clean first means your [regular house cleaning](/services/house-cleaning) visits can keep things at that level instead of catching up.
- **After a tough stretch** – a new baby, illness in the house, long work rosters or a renovation next door can leave things further behind than you'd like.

## What our deep cleaning in Newcastle includes

The full room-by-room checklist is further down the page. In short, we clean what's normally skipped:

- **Kitchen** – inside the oven, racks and trays; rangehood filters degreased; cupboard and drawer fronts, plus the insides of any you've emptied; fridge inside and out; splashback grout; tops of cupboards where reachable; bins washed.
- **Bathrooms** – shower screens descaled, grout scrubbed, exhaust fan covers cleaned, surface mould on ceilings and silicone treated, vanities cleaned inside and out, and toilets cleaned right down to the base.
- **Bedrooms and living areas** – skirting boards, door frames, doors and handles, light switches, ceiling fans, air-conditioner vent faces, reachable light fittings, and under and behind furniture we can safely move.
- **Windows** – inside glass, sills and tracks vacuumed and wiped.
- **Floors** – vacuumed and mopped, including edges and corners.

## How long it takes

Deep cleans take noticeably longer than regular visits. Ovens that haven't been touched in a while, heavy soap scum and mould all add time. We'll give you an idea of timing with your quote, and if you'd like us to prioritise particular rooms, tell us up front so they're done first.

## Newcastle conditions that make a deep clean worthwhile

Our climate and housing create build-up you don't see everywhere:

- **Humidity and mould** – summer humidity, especially in older homes and those close to the coast or the lake, encourages black spots on bathroom ceilings, grout, window frames and the backs of wardrobes. We treat surface mould as part of the job. If it keeps coming back, it's usually a ventilation or leak problem worth raising with a builder or your landlord.
- **Salt film** – homes in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Stockton](/areas/stockton), [Swansea](/areas/swansea) and [Belmont](/areas/belmont) get a salty haze on glass and aluminium that attracts dust and dulls frames.
- **Construction dust** – new estates such as [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm) and [Gillieston Heights](/areas/gillieston-heights) keep getting fine dust from neighbouring lots, and it builds up in tracks, vents and on high ledges.
- **Character homes** – heritage terraces and older cottages in [Cooks Hill](/areas/cooks-hill), [Hamilton](/areas/hamilton) and [Morpeth](/areas/morpeth) have cornices, picture rails, fireplaces and old timber that need gentle products and patience.

## What affects the price

Every deep clean is quoted to the home. The main factors are:

- Size of the home and number of bathrooms.
- Condition: how long since the last thorough clean, plus the state of the oven, shower screens and grout.
- Mould: how much, and where.
- Pets, and the hair and odours that come with them.
- Extras: inside windows on every floor, wall washing, balconies, the garage and outdoor areas.

Photos help us quote accurately, and quotes are always free with no obligation.

## Getting the most from your deep clean

- Clear benches and floors where you can, so the team spends its time cleaning rather than moving things.
- Empty the cupboards, wardrobes and fridge you want cleaned inside.
- Tell us about delicate surfaces such as natural stone, polished timber or antique furniture.
- Keep pets in a separate room or outdoors while we're working.
- Let us know about any areas that are off limits, such as a home office or a room with fragile items.

body:
Buyers make up their minds fast. They notice grubby grout in listing photos, smell a stale fridge at the open home and run a finger along the window sills. Our pre-sale cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter gets your property ready for the camera and for the first open, so the house is what people remember, not the mess. We work around your agent's timeline, bring our own equipment and products, and focus on the details buyers check.

## What our pre-sale cleaning in Newcastle focuses on

A pre-sale clean is similar to a deep clean, but the priorities are set by what buyers and photographers see:

- **First impressions** – front door, screen door and door handles cleaned, porch swept, and cobwebs removed from eaves and entry lights.
- **Kitchen** – benchtops polished, oven and cooktop degreased, rangehood cleaned, cupboard fronts and handles wiped, insides of cupboards cleaned (buyers do open them), and the sink and tapware polished.
- **Bathrooms** – shower glass descaled, grout scrubbed, mirrors and taps polished, exhaust fans cleaned and any surface mould treated.
- **Glass and light** – inside windows, sills and tracks cleaned, and sliding doors and balustrade glass polished so views and natural light come through in photos.
- **Floors and finishes** – skirting boards, doors and light switches wiped; floors vacuumed and mopped.

## Who books a pre-sale clean

- **Homeowners selling** who are juggling packing, repairs and an agent's schedule.
- **Landlords and investors** selling a property after tenants move out.
- **Executors and families** preparing a deceased estate for sale.
- **Builders and developers** listing new homes or apartments after construction.
- **Agents** who want a reliable team to get a listing ready on time.

## Timing it with your campaign

The best results come from timing the clean around your marketing:

1. **After repairs and decluttering** – painting, minor repairs and packing should come first, because they create dust and move furniture around.
2. **Before the photographer** – book the main clean a day or two before photos so glass, benchtops and floors look their best.
3. **Before staging** – if you're using [property staging](/services/property-staging), we clean first so furniture and styling go into a clean home.
4. **Touch-ups before opens** – a short visit before the first open home, or before each one in a long campaign, keeps bathrooms, the kitchen and floors at photo standard.

Tell us your agent's dates when you request a quote and we'll plan around them.

## Living there or vacant?

**Vacant homes** are straightforward: we can reach every surface, clean inside wardrobes and cupboards, and the result lasts until the first open. **Occupied homes** take more planning. We work room by room around your belongings, and you'll need to keep on top of everyday mess between opens. A common approach is a full pre-sale clean followed by quick touch-ups before each open. Between opens, a few habits help: wipe the shower screen after each use, keep benchtops clear, empty the bins the night before, and put pet bowls and beds away before buyers arrive.

## Selling in Newcastle and the Hunter

Local properties have their own selling points, and the clean should bring them forward:

A clean workplace gets noticed by the people who walk in, and taken for granted by the people who work there, until it slips. - **Medical and allied health rooms** – general cleaning of reception areas, consulting rooms and amenities.
- **Retail and showrooms** – shopfront glass, floors, fitting rooms and staff areas.

## What our commercial cleaning in Newcastle covers

- **Reception and entry** – entry glass and doors, reception desk, seating, mats and floors.
- **Workstations and offices** – desks and clear work surfaces wiped, bins and recycling emptied, ledges and partitions dusted.
- **Kitchens and breakout areas** – benches, sinks, tables and chairs cleaned, microwave cleaned inside and out, and fridge and appliance fronts wiped.
- **Bathrooms and amenities** – toilets, urinals and basins cleaned and sanitised, mirrors and partitions wiped, floors mopped, and consumables restocked from your supplies.
- **Meeting rooms** – tables, chairs and glass cleaned and the room reset.
- **Floors** – carpets vacuumed and hard floors mopped, including edges and under desks.
- **Touchpoints** – door handles, light switches, lift buttons and stair rails wiped on every visit.

Periodic tasks, such as high dusting, inside the fridge, window tracks and skirting boards, are scheduled weekly, monthly or quarterly depending on your site.

## How we set up your cleaning

1. **Site walk-through** – we visit, look at the space and ask how it's used: staff numbers, peak times, problem areas and access.
2. **Scope and schedule** – you get a written scope and a quote, with the frequency and times agreed.
3. **First clean** – the first visit usually includes some catch-up work to bring the site up to standard.
4. **Regular service** – the same checklist on every visit, with any issues reported back to you.
5. **Review** – as your business changes, we adjust the scope and schedule with you.

## Keys, security and after-hours work

Most commercial cleaning happens when your team isn't there. Before the first clean, we agree how keys, swipe cards and alarm codes are handled, which doors and windows need to be locked, and who to call if something isn't right. If your building has sign-in procedures or site rules, we follow them.

- Floor area and layout, including the number of levels.

Builders finish, trades pack up, and the house or fit-out looks done, until you run a hand along a window sill. Plaster dust, paint flecks, silicone smears, stickers and sawdust get everywhere during construction, including places nobody thinks to check. Our post-construction cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter removes all of it, so a new home, renovation or commercial fit-out is ready for handover, sale or the first day of trade.

## Who we clean for

- **Builders and developers** handing over new homes, townhouses and apartments.
- **Renovators and homeowners** moving back in after a kitchen, bathroom or whole-of-house renovation.
- **Commercial fit-outs** – offices, shops, clinics and hospitality venues getting ready to open.
- **Property managers and investors** preparing a newly built or renovated property for tenants or sale.

## What our post-construction cleaning in Newcastle removes

Construction dust is fine enough to settle on every surface and get inside every cupboard. Our team works top to bottom so dust isn't knocked onto surfaces that are already clean:

- **Dust** – from cornices, door tops, architraves, skirting boards, light fittings, vents and exhaust fan covers, and inside cupboards, drawers and wardrobes.
- **Paint, plaster and filler** – spots and smears removed from glass, frames, tiles and fixtures, using tools and products suited to each surface.
- **Silicone and adhesive** – excess silicone smears and sticker and label residue removed from windows, tapware, appliances and fixtures.
- **Protective films** – peeled from appliances, windows and fixtures once you're ready.
- **Windows and tracks** – glass cleaned inside and reachable outside, and tracks vacuumed and wiped clear of grit and sawdust.
- **Floors** – hard floors vacuumed and mopped, usually more than once to lift fine dust, light grout haze removed from tiles where practical, and carpets vacuumed.

The full area-by-area checklist is further down the page.

## Cleaning in stages

Larger builds usually need more than one visit:

1. **Builders clean (rough clean)** – once major trades are finished, we remove dust, debris and residue so finishing trades and inspections aren't working in a mess.
2. **Final clean** – after the last trades, a detailed clean of every surface, inside and out of cupboards, glass, tracks and floors.
3. **Touch-up (sparkle clean)** – a quick visit just before handover, a practical completion inspection or settlement, to catch dust that has settled since the final clean and any marks from last-minute work.

Smaller renovations often only need a final clean. We'll recommend what suits your project when you request a quote.

## What we need from you

- **Trades finished** in the areas we're cleaning, or a clear plan for which areas are ready.
- **Builder's rubbish, offcuts and skips** cleared before we start; we take away our own cleaning waste.
- **Power and water** connected so we can run our equipment and use hot water.
- **Site rules** – if your site needs inductions, sign-in or specific personal protective equipment, tell us at quote time so we can plan for it.
- **Key dates** – tell us your inspection, handover or settlement date, so the final clean and touch-up land as close to it as possible.

## Local building conditions

Construction across the region brings its own challenges:

- **Growing estates** in [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm), [Thornton](/areas/thornton), [Lochinvar](/areas/lochinvar), [Gillieston Heights](/areas/gillieston-heights) and [Medowie](/areas/medowie) are surrounded by bare lots, and fine red-brown dust keeps blowing in while neighbouring homes go up. It's worth timing your final clean as close to handover as possible.
- **Knock-down rebuilds and renovations** in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [New Lambton](/areas/new-lambton) and [Adamstown](/areas/adamstown) usually mean working beside lived-in homes, with tight driveways and street parking.
- **Apartments** in [Wickham](/areas/wickham), Newcastle West and around Honeysuckle involve lifts, loading docks and strata rules, which we plan around.
- **Heritage renovations** in [Cooks Hill](/areas/cooks-hill), [Maitland](/areas/maitland) and [Morpeth](/areas/morpeth) often combine new work with original timber, leadlight and sandstone, which need gentle methods.
- **Coastal builds** pick up salt spray on new glass and aluminium frames within weeks of the windows going in.

## What affects the price

- Size of the property and number of levels.
- Stage of the clean (builders, final or touch-up) and how many visits you need.
- How much dust, paint and residue is left behind.
- Amount of glass, including large sliding doors and balustrades.
- Height and access, such as raked ceilings or voids.
- Site rules and the time available before handover.

## Ready for handover?

Send us your plans, photos or a description of the job. [Request a free quote](/quote) or call 0411 463 552. Selling the finished home? Pair your final clean with [property staging](/services/property-staging), and for ongoing cleaning of a new office, see our [commercial cleaning](/services/commercial-cleaning).

body:
Buyers find it hard to picture life in an empty room. A vacant living area can look smaller than it is, a third bedroom can read as a storeroom, and listing photos of bare floors rarely stop anyone scrolling. Our property staging service in Newcastle and the Hunter uses furniture, styling and decor to show how a home works: where the lounge goes, how the dining area flows to the deck, and that the main bedroom fits a queen bed with room to spare. We pair staging with pre-sale cleaning, so your property is clean, styled and ready before the photographer arrives.

## What property staging involves

Staging is about presentation, not decoration for its own sake. Depending on the property and the campaign, it can mean:

- **Furnishing a vacant home** – living, dining and bedrooms set up so buyers see scale and purpose.
- **Styling key rooms** – focusing on the rooms that matter most in photos, usually the living area, dining, kitchen and main bedroom.
- **Working with an occupied home** – adding pieces, cushions, art and accessories, and suggesting what to move out, so your own furniture works harder.
- **Outdoor areas** – a balcony or alfresco set up to show it's a place to sit, eat and relax.

We'll walk through the property and recommend what's worth doing for your home and your budget.

## Why property staging in Newcastle works best with cleaning

Styling only works in a clean house. Dust on skirting boards, marks on glass and grubby grout all show up in high-resolution listing photos, and they stand out even more next to fresh linen and new cushions. That's why we schedule a [pre-sale clean](/services/pre-sale-cleaning) before the furniture goes in, and offer touch-ups before open homes. One team handling both means fewer people to coordinate and a single timeline that matches your agent's.

## How it works

1. **Consultation** – we walk through the property, talk about the likely buyers, and check access for delivery: stairs, lifts, driveways and parking.
2. **Styling plan and quote** – you get a plan for each room, the hire period and a clear quote.
3. **Pre-sale clean** – the property is cleaned top to bottom before staging.
4. **Delivery and install** – furniture and styling go in ahead of your photography date.
5. **Campaign** – photos, inspections and open homes. If the campaign runs longer than planned, talk to us about extending the hire.
6. **Collection** – once the property sells or the hire ends, we collect everything.

## Staging for Newcastle and Hunter buyers

The right styling depends on the property and who is likely to buy it:

- **Heritage terraces and cottages** in [Cooks Hill](/areas/cooks-hill), [The Junction](/areas/the-junction) and [Hamilton](/areas/hamilton) have narrow halls and steep stairs. Furniture needs to be scaled to fit, and the styling should let timber floors, fireplaces and high ceilings do the talking.
- **Apartments** in [Newcastle East](/areas/newcastle-east), [Wickham](/areas/wickham) and around Honeysuckle are sold on light and views. Low-profile furniture keeps sightlines open to the harbour or the ocean, and we plan around lift bookings and loading areas.
- **Family homes** in [Lake Macquarie](/areas/lake-macquarie), [Maitland](/areas/maitland) and new estates such as [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm) appeal to families, so the staging shows kids' bedrooms, a study nook and outdoor entertaining.
- **Coastal and lake homes** in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Warners Bay](/areas/warners-bay) and [Nelson Bay](/areas/nelson-bay) suit relaxed, light styling that doesn't compete with the view.
- **Hunter Valley properties** around [Pokolbin](/areas/pokolbin) and [Cessnock](/areas/cessnock), from cottages to acreage homes, often attract lifestyle and weekender buyers, so verandahs and outdoor living deserve as much attention as the lounge room.

## What affects the price

Every staging job is quoted individually. The main factors are:

- **Number of rooms** staged, and whether the home is vacant or occupied.
- **Size and access** – stairs, lifts, long carries and parking all affect delivery and install time.
- **Hire period** – agreed upfront, with the option to extend.
- **Location** – delivery distance across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Port Stephens, the Hunter Valley and Singleton.
- **Cleaning** – whether you add a pre-sale clean and touch-ups before opens.

## Working with your agent

Your real estate agent knows the local market and the likely buyers, and we're happy to work with them on timing and styling. Tell us your photography date and first open home when you get in touch, and we'll plan the clean, delivery and install around them.

body:
Short-stay guests judge a property in the first five minutes. Hair in the shower, a crumb-covered toaster or a bed that isn't quite right sticks in their memory, and the clean that prevents it has to fit between a morning check-out and an afternoon check-in. Our Airbnb and holiday rental cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter handles those turnovers for hosts and property managers: cleaning, bed-making with your linen, restocking your supplies and reporting anything that needs your attention.

## What our Airbnb cleaning in Newcastle covers on every turnover

- **Kitchen** – benches, splashback, sink and cooktop cleaned; dishes washed or the dishwasher unloaded; microwave, kettle and toaster cleaned; fridge checked and cleared of guest leftovers; bins emptied.
- **Bathrooms** – shower, screen, bath, basin and toilet cleaned and sanitised; mirrors polished; hair removed from drains and floors; fresh towels set out.
- **Bedrooms** – used linen stripped and bagged, beds made with fresh linen you supply, surfaces dusted, and wardrobes and drawers checked for anything left behind.
- **Living areas** – surfaces dusted and wiped, cushions and throws arranged, remotes wiped, and floors vacuumed and mopped.
- **Outdoor areas** – balconies and decks swept, outdoor furniture wiped, and the barbecue checked if it's part of the listing.
- **Guest-ready checks** – supplies restocked from your stock, lights and appliances checked, and doors and windows locked.

## Reporting back to you

Hosts can't see the property between guests, so we're your eyes on site. After each turnover, we can let you know about:

- Damage, breakages or stains.
- Items guests have left behind.
- Supplies running low, such as toilet paper, coffee pods or dishwasher tablets.
- Maintenance issues such as a dripping tap, a blown globe or a sticky lock.

Photos make it easy to pass information on to guests, the booking platform or your maintenance contact.

## Keeping every stay consistent

Guests compare your property with the photos in your listing, so we present every room the same way each time: towels folded the same, beds made the same, and welcome items placed exactly where you want them. If your listing photos change, send us the new ones and we'll match them.

## How turnovers work

1. **Set-up visit** – we walk through the property with you or your notes, learn how you like it presented, and find out where linen and supplies are kept.
2. **Booking schedule** – send us your check-out and check-in dates, or share your calendar, so we know when to arrive.
3. **Turnover clean** – the team cleans, restocks and presents the property to your standard.
4. **Report** – you get a quick note, with photos of anything that needs attention.
5. **Periodic deep cleans** – between busy seasons, a [deep clean](/services/deep-cleaning) catches up on ovens, windows and grout.

## Holiday rentals across Newcastle and the Hunter

- **Beach stays** in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Newcastle East](/areas/newcastle-east) and [Stockton](/areas/stockton) come with sand in beds, showers and sliding door tracks, and salt on the glass.
- **Port Stephens holiday homes** in [Nelson Bay](/areas/nelson-bay) and [Fern Bay](/areas/fern-bay) are flat out over summer and school holidays, often with same-day changeovers, and quieter through winter.
- **Wine country cottages** in [Pokolbin](/areas/pokolbin) and around [Cessnock](/areas/cessnock) peak on weekends, with wedding parties and concert crowds checking out on Sunday or Monday.
- **Lake houses** around [Warners Bay](/areas/warners-bay), [Belmont](/areas/belmont) and [Swansea](/areas/swansea) attract family groups who use every room, the barbecue and the deck.
- **City apartments** close to the CBD, the hospitals and the University of Newcastle host work travellers and visiting families who expect a hotel-like standard.

## What affects the price

- Size of the property and number of beds and bathrooms.
- How long guests stayed and how many there were.
- Whether linen changes, dishes and restocking are included.
- Same-day turnover windows, and weekend or public holiday work.
- Outdoor areas, barbecues and extras such as spa baths.

## Tips for smoother turnovers

- Keep at least two full sets of linen and towels for every bed, so one set can be laundered while the other is in use.
- Use a lockbox or smart lock so access doesn't depend on someone being home.
- Keep a labelled supply cupboard with spare consumables.
- Give us a photo of how you want each room presented.
- Tell us about any house rules guests often break, such as smoking or extra visitors, so we know what to look for.

heroIntro: Sand, dust, pet hair and spills sink deep into carpet long before it looks dirty. Our carpet steam cleaning uses hot water extraction to lift grime out of the fibres for homes and rentals across Newcastle and the Hunter, and pairs easily with an end of lease, deep or pre-sale clean.
summary: Hot water extraction for carpets in homes and rentals, with pre-treatment of traffic areas and common stains.
body:
Carpet hides more than it shows. Sand from the beach, dust from the garden, pet hair, spilled drinks and everyday foot traffic sink into the pile long before the carpet looks dirty. Our carpet steam cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter uses hot water extraction to lift that grime out of the fibres, not just off the surface. It's a common add-on to end of lease and pre-sale cleans, and a regular job for families with kids and pets.

## How carpet steam cleaning works

"Steam cleaning" is the common name for hot water extraction. The process runs like this:

1. **Inspection** – we check the carpet type, its condition and any stains, and tell you what's likely to come out and what might not.
2. **Vacuum** – a thorough dry vacuum lifts loose soil, sand and hair.
3. **Pre-treatment** – traffic lanes and spots are treated with a solution suited to the fibre and the stain.
4. **Hot water extraction** – hot water is pushed into the pile and extracted along with the soil it loosens.
5. **Grooming and drying** – the pile is groomed, and we give you tips to speed up drying.

## What our carpet steam cleaning in Newcastle includes

- **Bedrooms** – carpet cleaned edge to edge, including inside built-in wardrobes when they're empty.
- **Living and dining areas** – traffic lanes pre-treated and cleaned, with light furniture moved and replaced.
- **Hallways and stairs** – stair treads and risers cleaned, and high-traffic hallways given extra attention.
- **Spot and stain treatment** – common stains such as food, drinks, mud and pet accidents treated.
- **Deodorising** – available on request.

## Drying times

Most carpets are dry within several hours, but it depends on the carpet, the weather and ventilation. Newcastle's humid summer days and cold, still winter mornings both slow things down. To help:

- Open windows, run fans or use the air-conditioning.
- Keep foot traffic to a minimum, and wear clean socks rather than shoes.
- Put furniture back on protective tabs or foil until the carpet is fully dry.
- Keep pets off the carpet until it has dried.

## Carpet cleaning at the end of a lease

Check your lease and your ingoing condition report. If professional carpet cleaning is required, keep your invoice to show your agent. Book the carpets after the main [end of lease clean](/services/end-of-lease-cleaning) so the floors aren't walked on once they're done, and allow drying time before the final inspection.

## Stains and odours: what to expect

Hot water extraction removes most everyday soiling and many stains, but not everything:

- **Permanent damage** such as bleach marks, dye transfers and burns can't be cleaned out, because the colour of the fibre itself has changed.
- **Old or set stains** may lighten rather than disappear.
- **Pet urine** that has soaked into the underlay can leave an odour that surface cleaning alone doesn't fully resolve.
- **Wear** in traffic lanes can look like dirt but is actually crushed or worn fibre.

We'll be honest about all of this before we start, so there are no surprises.

## Local conditions

- **Beach suburbs** like [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Stockton](/areas/stockton) and [Nelson Bay](/areas/nelson-bay) grind sand into carpets, which wears the fibres faster. Regular vacuuming and periodic extraction help them last.
- **New estates** in [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm) and [Thornton](/areas/thornton) track red-brown dust in from building sites, and light-coloured carpets show it quickly.
- **Student rentals** near the University of Newcastle in [Jesmond](/areas/jesmond) and [Shortland](/areas/shortland) see a lot of foot traffic, spills and furniture shuffling in a short time.
- **Older homes** in [Lambton](/areas/lambton) and [Mayfield](/areas/mayfield) may have older carpet that needs a gentler approach.
- **Humid weather** across the coast and lake means carpets in poorly ventilated rooms can develop a musty smell, which extraction and good airflow afterwards can help with.

## What affects the price

- Number and size of rooms, hallways and stairs.
- Carpet condition, traffic lanes and stains.
- Pet hair and odours.
- Furniture that needs moving.
- Whether it's combined with another clean.

## How often should carpets be cleaned?

Busy family homes and homes with pets benefit from professional cleaning more often than quiet households. Rentals usually need it at the end of a tenancy if the lease requires it. Between professional cleans, regular vacuuming and treating spills quickly make the biggest difference to how long carpet lasts.

faqs.q: Will steam cleaning remove all stains?
faqs.a: It removes most everyday soiling and many stains. Permanent damage such as bleach marks, dye transfers and burns can't be cleaned out, and old stains may lighten rather than disappear. We'll tell you before we start.

faqs.a: We move light furniture and put it back. Heavy items such as wardrobes, pianos and loaded bookcases should be moved beforehand, or we'll clean around them.

faqs.q: Can you remove pet urine odour?

h1: Window Cleaning in Newcastle & the Hunter
heroIntro: Salt spray, lake breezes and building dust leave a film on glass faster than most people expect. We clean windows, frames, tracks and flyscreens inside and out for homes and shopfronts across Newcastle and the Hunter, so you get the light and the view back.
summary: Glass, frames, tracks and flyscreens cleaned inside and out for homes and shopfronts.
body:
Clean windows change how a room feels: more light, clearer views and a house that looks cared for from the street. Our window cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter covers glass, frames, sills, tracks and flyscreens, inside and out, for homes and shopfronts. It's especially worthwhile close to the coast, where salt spray leaves a haze that dulls glass within weeks, and in growing estates where building dust settles on every ledge.

## What our window cleaning in Newcastle includes

- **Glass** – inside and outside panes cleaned and squeegeed streak-free, including sliding doors.
- **Frames and sills** – wiped down to remove dust, salt and grime.
- **Tracks** – vacuumed and wiped to clear grit, sand and dead insects, so doors and windows slide properly.
- **Flyscreens** – dusted or washed, depending on their condition.
- **Balustrades and balcony glass** – cleaned on both sides where safely accessible.
- **Shopfronts** – entry glass, doors and display windows for businesses.

## Salt, sand and dust: why Newcastle windows get dirty fast

- **Salt spray** – homes in [Merewether](/areas/merewether), [Newcastle East](/areas/newcastle-east), [Stockton](/areas/stockton), [Nelson Bay](/areas/nelson-bay) and [Swansea](/areas/swansea) get a salty film that attracts dust and, left too long, can be hard to shift. Coastal homes generally need more frequent cleaning than inland ones.
- **Lake breezes** – lakefront homes around [Warners Bay](/areas/warners-bay), [Speers Point](/areas/speers-point) and [Belmont](/areas/belmont) collect a mix of moisture, pollen and dust.
- **Building dust** – new estates such as [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm) and [Gillieston Heights](/areas/gillieston-heights) get fine dust from nearby building sites on glass and in tracks.
- **Road and rail dust** – homes near busy roads and rail lines pick up fine grime that greys windows and sills.
- **Rural dust** – homes on acreage around [Singleton](/areas/singleton) and the Hunter Valley get dust from dry paddocks and gravel roads, especially in late summer.

## Heritage and character windows

Older homes in [Cooks Hill](/areas/cooks-hill), [Hamilton](/areas/hamilton), [Maitland](/areas/maitland) and [Morpeth](/areas/morpeth) often have timber sash windows, leadlight and original glass. We use gentle methods and take care around old putty, timber and leadwork. Sash windows that are painted shut or have broken cords can limit what we can reach from inside, and we'll let you know if that's the case.

## Before we arrive

- Move furniture, ornaments and plants away from windows where you can.
- Leave window locks and screen doors open, or put the keys out for us.
- Let us know about pets in the yard, and any windows that stick or have broken latches.
- Tell us if any glass has tinting or film, so we use the right method.

## How a window clean runs

1. **Quote** – tell us roughly how many windows, sliding doors and storeys you have, or send photos.
2. **Access check** – we confirm which windows can be safely reached from inside, from the ground or with ladders, and whether we need access inside the home.
3. **Clean** – we work through glass, frames, tracks and screens, inside and out.
4. **Check** – we look over each window in good light for streaks and missed spots.

## Height and safety

We clean single-storey windows and upper-level windows that can be reached safely. Windows that need rope access, boom lifts or scaffolding aren't included, and we'll tell you up front if any of your windows fall into that category.

## Hard water and stubborn marks

Some marks aren't dirt. Mineral stains from sprinklers or bore water, etching from long-term salt build-up and scratches are part of the glass itself and may need specialist restoration rather than cleaning. Paint and cement splashes from building work can often be removed with care. We'll point these out before we start.

## How often should windows be cleaned?

It depends on where you live and how much you value the view:

- **Coastal homes** – more often, particularly on the side facing the ocean.
- **Inland and suburban homes** – a few times a year is usually enough.
- **Before an event or sale** – a clean before an open home or photography makes a big difference; see our [pre-sale cleaning](/services/pre-sale-cleaning).
- **Shopfronts** – often weekly or fortnightly, because customers see the glass every day.

## What affects the price

- Number and size of windows and sliding doors.
- Number of storeys and how easy the windows are to reach.
- Flyscreens and the condition of tracks.
- Salt, mineral or paint build-up.
- Whether it's combined with a deep clean or regular service.

## Book a window clean

[Request a free quote](/quote) or call 0411 463 552. For inside windows as part of a full-house reset, see our [deep cleaning](/services/deep-cleaning) service, or add windows to your [regular house cleaning](/services/house-cleaning).

h1: NDIS Cleaning Support in Newcastle & the Hunter
heroIntro: Regular cleaning support can make living independently at home easier. summary: Regular, respectful household cleaning for NDIS participants, on a schedule that fits your routine.
body:
A clean, safe home makes everyday life easier, and for many people living with disability, regular cleaning support is part of what makes living independently at home practical. Our NDIS cleaning service in Newcastle and the Hunter provides reliable household cleaning on a schedule that suits you, carried out by a trained, respectful team who work around your routines, your support workers and the way you like your home kept.

## Who it's for

- **NDIS participants** living in their own home or a rental who want help with household cleaning.
- **Families and carers** who'd like to take cleaning off their list so they can focus on support.
- **Support coordinators and plan managers** arranging household help for a participant.
- **Shared living arrangements** where housemates need common areas kept clean.

## What our NDIS cleaning in Newcastle includes

Each visit follows a checklist agreed with you:

- **Kitchen** – benches, sink and cooktop cleaned, appliance fronts wiped, bins emptied and floors mopped.
- **Bathrooms** – shower, bath, basin and toilet cleaned, mirrors polished and floors mopped, with extra care around grab rails and shower chairs.
- **Bedrooms** – surfaces dusted, beds made and linen changed if you'd like, and floors vacuumed.
- **Living areas** – dusting, wiping and vacuuming, with floors kept clear so mobility aids can move freely.
- **Laundry** – tub and benches wiped and the floor mopped.

The full room-by-room list is further down the page.

## Using NDIS funding

Whether you can use NDIS funding for our cleaning depends on your plan and how it's managed. We recommend checking with your plan manager, support coordinator or the NDIA before booking. We'll give you a clear written quote and invoices with the details your plan manager needs, and you can always pay privately if you prefer.

## How we work with you

- **Meet first** – we talk with you, and your family or support person if you'd like, about what you need, how you like things done and anything we should know about access or safety.
- **A regular schedule** – weekly or fortnightly visits on set days, so you know when we're coming.
- **Consistency** – we aim to send the same people each visit where we can, because familiar faces matter.
- **Communication your way** – phone, text or email, or through a family member or coordinator.
- **Respect for your home** – we put things back where you keep them and follow your house rules.
- **Flexibility** – if you're unwell, have an appointment or your routine changes, let us know and we'll move the visit.

## Safety in your home

If you use mobility aids, have an assistance animal, or there's anything about your home we should know for safety, tell us before the first visit. We'll plan how we enter, where we put our equipment and how we leave floors, so walkways stay clear and dry.

## Products and sensitivities

Many people are sensitive to fragrances or strong chemicals. Eco-friendly products are available on request, and if you'd prefer we use your own products, we're happy to. Tell us about allergies, sensory needs or anything else that would make a visit more comfortable, such as working in a particular order, keeping noise down, or avoiding certain rooms at certain times.

## Supporting independence across Newcastle and the Hunter

We work across Newcastle, [Lake Macquarie](/areas/lake-macquarie), [Maitland](/areas/maitland), [Port Stephens](/areas/port-stephens), Cessnock and Singleton. Local conditions shape the job:

- **Older homes** in suburbs such as [Mayfield](/areas/mayfield), [Wallsend](/areas/wallsend) and [Cessnock](/areas/cessnock) can have steps, narrow hallways and older bathrooms, so we take extra care with access and slippery surfaces.
- **Coastal and lake homes** in [Belmont](/areas/belmont), [Swansea](/areas/swansea) and [Stockton](/areas/stockton) are prone to humidity and mould in bathrooms, which regular cleaning helps keep under control.
- **Newer accessible homes** in growing areas like [Thornton](/areas/thornton) and [Chisholm](/areas/chisholm) pick up dust from nearby building sites, especially in window tracks and on floors.

## What we don't do

Our team provides cleaning only. We don't provide personal care, medication support, community access or other disability supports. If you need those, your support coordinator can help you find the right provider.

## What affects the price

- The size of your home and the number of rooms included.
- How often we visit and how long each visit is.
- Extra tasks such as linen changes, or inside the oven and fridge.
- The condition of the home at the start; a first deep clean may be recommended.

## Get started

Call 0411 463 552 or [request a free quote](/quote) and tell us a little about your home and what would help. We can also arrange a one-off [deep clean](/services/deep-cleaning) to get things to a good starting point before regular [house cleaning](/services/house-cleaning) visits begin.
